letter.envelope.collapsed_mail_hub.commo:
Last Warning

  You promised to pay two times already. This is the last reminder.

  Pay for the tools by next week, or we will terminate all contracts with your shop and spread the word to other suppliers.

Metal can fly?

  I've heard from my neighbor that this mail service we're using is operating from huge metal platforms in the sky. Can you believe that? That's just silly! Metal is heavier than air, that I'm sure of!

  Then again, I haven't seen any mail service buildings on the ground... Do you think it's possible? If so - how?... And why?

Missing Package

  The armor package never arrived. I waited three whole days - nothing.

  Hopefully you can send me a replacement, as it was not cheap in the slightest.

My Brother

  Two weeks ago my brother went to the mines with his crew, as usual. But I haven't heard of him since...

  Nobody knows or heard anything about him or any of his mates. I cannot stand this anymore. What could have happened to them? What do I do?...

Our Farm

  Great news! After months of work our farm is finally starting to come together. Everything seems to go smoothly and orders are starting to ramp up!

  We couldn't do it without your help. We'll prepare some meat to send you.

  Thank you!

Junk Mail

  Have you got one of those junk mails already? Last one I got was about some horse thing, or something. I didn't even read it all, thrown it into the trash immediately!

  Another one of those and I'll break my mailbox in half, I swear!

Supply Service

  You should try that %s they've set up recently. It's pretty convenient! 

  I only wish they'd add more products to it.

  Maybe one day we wouldn't even need our markets at all? Buy and sell everything from the comfort of our home! Isn't that a dream?
letter.envelope.collapsed_mail_hub.nethe:
Riches Below

  As I hoped, pursuing portal development was entirely worth it! You would be amazed by how many resources lie on the other side, and we have only scratched the surface!

  I still have some leftovers from my portal. I will send them as soon as possible. Hurry, before someone else gets there first!

Treasures Await!

  That place is unimaginable!
I knew spending so much on the portal would pay off — and it absolutely did!

  I have sent you some leftovers from mine.

  Join us as soon as possible. There is so much to gain there, you would be amazed!

We will be rich!

  I managed to sneak through the portal they built. It is... It is even better than we thought! There's so much gold and other valuables here! We will be be rich!

  Take all spare Obsidian you have. The frame is indeed made of it, as we tried, but, I guess, it's the size? We need to continue work as soon as possible.

Portal Report

  Our experiment was a success. After several iterations, the portal functioned as intended.

  The other side was far different than we anticipated. Temperatures are much higher than here, but manageable.

  Collection and study of the local resources is ongoing.

Portal Report

  The portal experiment was a success. It did not take long to make it work.

  The other side is far more challenging. The temperature can be a problem, but manageable.

  Extractable resources are plentiful. Many specimens are invaluable. Some require further study.

Possibility of Expansion

  They have shown me their portal and want us to expand our service to the other side. Foolish idea, if you ask me. From what I've seen, the environment there is not suited for deliveries.

  But we do not have much choice. Without their investment, we wouldn't even be able to keep existing stuff afloat. Hopefully it all works out somehow...

Concerning Portals

  Have you seen the portals? It's a hot new thing right now. Everyone wants to get their part of it.

  It worries me... We don't even know if it's safe! Who knows what unimaginable dangers are hiding in there?

  We should be careful..

Alarming Discoveries

  I've been able to get my hands on a sample from beyond the portal. Having spent the last week analyzing it - the results are not positive:

[ 36% | 22% | 17% | 16% | 9% ]

  Find whoever is in charge of the expedition and show them the data. They should stop immediately. I hope it's not too late...

letter.envelope.abandoned_mineshaft.jour:
... 

  Four days have passed since the entrance collapsed. All attempts to dig it out have yielded nothing...

  We don't have much supplies left. Maybe for a couple of days...

  ...

... 

  Sitting here on the cold, damp stone, with little to no light, the scary stories my sister used to tell me grow more believable with each passing day.

  Were they only stories?...

  ...

... 

  The growling won't stop... 

  Is it coming from one of these old tunnels? Or is it in my head?...

  I think I'm going mad...
